stories.title: Teruaki Sato Officially Posted — NPB Triple Crown Winner on the Clock

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Teruaki Sato is officially posted to MLB.

2026 NPB Triple Crown winner. 45-day window to sign.

Mets, Yankees, Dodgers, Phillies all interested.

Catch: posting window freezes Dec 1 with the CBA.

Seiya Suzuki situation could repeat.

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Quick breakdown on Teruaki Sato's MLB posting:

— 2026 NPB Triple Crown (Hanshin Tigers)
— Expected to play 1B in MLB
— Window closes Dec 1 with the CBA lockout
— Teams: Mets, Yankees, Dodgers, Phillies

If no deal by December 1, Sato goes back to Japan for another year.

stories.title: Skubal Signing Race — Dodgers and Mets Emerge as Frontrunners

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Tarik Skubal's free agency opens tomorrow (Nov. 2, 5 PM ET).

Dodgers got a boost. Mets are "committed." Cubs, Phillies, Red Sox lurking.

Back-to-back Cy Young. Projected $350M-$500M.

This is the biggest pitcher signing in history.

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The Skubal stakes if no deal before December 1:

— CBA expires, lockout begins
— No deals can be made during lockout
— He waits until a new CBA is signed (99 days in 2022)
— 2027 Opening Day potentially delayed

Everyone wants this done fast. Skubal most of all.

Freddy Peralta: Split between Mets (4.99) and Rays (3.25). Projected 5yr/$140M.

Not Skubal — but in a lockout winter, these deals get done fast.
